news.title: Nivin Pauly Starrer Bethlehem Kudumba Unit Locks OTT Date
news.summary: The Malayalam romantic comedy drama Bethlehem Kudumba Unit is heading to JioHotstar on October 2 following a successful theatrical run. Directed by Girish A.D. and starring Nivin Pauly alongside Mamitha Baiju, the film has crossed Rs 325 crore globally. The narrative centers on a bachelor whose routine changes after a new neighbor moves into his area.

news.title: Suriya Advises Admirers to Ignore Digital Trolls
news.summary: Tamil actor Suriya recently advised his fan clubs to avoid getting pulled into social media negativity and controversies. During an interaction, he stressed that responding to critics wastes valuable time and energy. Instead, he encouraged his supporters to channel all their focus into personal growth and hard work.

news.title: Can Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 Reach the Coveted 1000 Crore Mark?
news.summary: Superstar Rajinikanth's highly anticipated sequel Jailer 2 is carrying massive pre-release business targets around ₹600 crore. Directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, the film aims to push Tamil cinema toward the unprecedented ₹1000 crore worldwide milestone. However, trade analysts note that current promotional buzz and single tracks need stronger momentum ahead of its October 15 release.

news.title: Rajinikanth and Kamal Haasan's Dharman Eyes a Major Festival Launch
news.summary: Rajinikanth's 173rd film Dharman, backed by Kamal Haasan's Raaj Kamal Films International, is gearing up for a Pongal 2027 theatrical arrival. Directed by Ashwath Marimuthu, the action thriller also features a prominent Telugu connection with Ram Pothineni joining the ensemble. Production is currently progressing swiftly with high-octane sequences underway.

news.title: Mahesh Babu's Post-Varanasi Venture Sparks Speculation
news.summary: Mahesh Babu is nearing the completion of his portions for SS Rajamouli's Varanasi, which features Priyanka Chopra Jonas and Prithviraj Sukumaran and is slated for an April 7, 2027 release. As the superstar wraps up his dubbing work, rumors are swirling about who he will team up with next, with directors like Lokesh Kanagaraj entering the conversation. Although Lokesh's banner G Squad recently announced a collaboration with Mythri Movie Makers, no official confirmation has been made regarding an actor-director pairing with Mahesh.

news.title: Nani and Srikanth Odela Address Backlash Over Trolled Dialogue in The Paradise
news.summary: Following mixed reactions to a specific line in The Paradise where Kayadu Lohar's character is labeled a single-take artist, actor Nani and director Srikanth Odela opened up about the controversy. Srikanth explained that the line was meant to highlight ironic character depth, but the crucial backstory was ultimately edited out to preserve the film's runtime. Nani acknowledged that trimming essential setups can unfortunately lead audiences to misinterpret otherwise meaningful payoffs.

news.title: Taapsee Pannu Flaunts Vintage Style in Latest Photo Shoot
news.summary: Actor Taapsee Pannu recently turned heads by sharing a striking retro-themed fashion photo shoot featuring voluminous curls and a black-and-gold floral outfit. Amid a challenging box-office run in 2026 with Advocate Raavi and Gandhari, the actor continues to keep her focus forward. She is currently busy filming for Woh Ladki Hai Kahaan?, where she essays the role of ACP Komal Sharma.

news.title: NTR Set to Restart Dragon Filming in Mumbai
news.summary: Following a recovery break from a shoulder injury, NTR is gearing up to return to the sets of Dragon with a two-week schedule in Mumbai starting October 10. While director Prashanth Neel continued filming scenes that did not require the lead actor, the upcoming schedule will heavily focus on high-voltage action stunts. The high-budget venture, featuring a cast including Rukmini Vasanth, Anil Kapoor, and Biju Menon, is produced by Mythri Movie Makers and NTR Arts with music by Ravi Basrur.

news.title: Anil Ravipudi Nears Completion of January 12 Vidudala Shoot
news.summary: Filmmaker Anil Ravipudi is fast-tracking his upcoming project January 12 Vidudala, which stars Victory Venkatesh, Kalyanram, Keerthy Suresh, and Krithi Shetty. Following a brief pause while Venkatesh wrapped up pending scenes for Aadarsha Kutumbam, the team is set to resume filming in Ooty this October. Principal photography is slated to wrap up by mid-November, leaving ample time for post-production and background scoring by GV Prakash Kumar ahead of a January 12 theatrical release.

news.title: Nani's The Paradise Maintains Strong Box Office Momentum on Day Three
news.summary: Actor Nani's latest movie, The Paradise, continues to draw impressive crowds and steady figures at the box office following a record-breaking opening. Directed by Srikanth Odela and produced by Sudhakar Cherukuri, the film has enjoyed massive momentum with family audiences filling theatres on the holiday weekend. Advance bookings indicate exceptional demand as the project flexes Nani's dominant star power on the big screen.

news.title: Trailer Unveiled for Debutant Manga Srinivas's Chakkora
news.summary: The theatrical trailer for Chakkora – Lunar Love Bird has been released in Hyderabad, introducing a vibrant mix of romance, family drama, and mystery. The story follows a carefree young man named Ravana Brahma who falls instantly for Julie, only for her to mysteriously vanish and trigger a gripping search for answers. Directed by newcomer Manga Srinivas and starring Sravan and Malaika T. Vasupal, the musical entertainer hits global screens on October 9.

news.title: Makers of Ramayana Reveal Regal New Posters Featuring Ranbir Kapoor and Yash
news.summary: Director Nitesh Tiwari's ambitious mythological epic Ramayana has generated fresh buzz with striking new promotional artwork. A fresh poster showcases Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, and Ravi Dubey as Rama, Sita, and Lakshman against an expansive landscape of mountains and waterfalls. Additionally, the first look of Yash as the formidable antagonist Ravana highlights a commanding presence adorned in an ornate golden crown. Produced by Namit Malhotra, the first part of the cinematic event is slated for a Diwali 2026 release.

news.title: Trailer of Chakkora Unveils a Blend of Romance and Mystery
news.summary: Aakash Jagannadh recently launched the trailer for Chakkora – Lunar Love Bird in Hyderabad ahead of its theatrical release on October 9. Directed by Manga Srinivas, the film transitions from a lighthearted romantic tale into an emotional mystery following the sudden disappearance of the female lead, Julie. Backed by high-energy music from Prince Henry, the movie features Sravan and Malaika T. Vasupal in pivotal roles.

news.title: Nani's The Paradise Maintains Strong Weekend Box Office Numbers
news.summary: Despite receiving mixed initial reviews from critics following its release, Nani's The Paradise has continued to pull solid numbers at the box office. The makers reported a worldwide gross of 136 Cr in its first three days, driven by a surge in collections across the Telugu states and favorable overseas momentum. The core team recently celebrated this commercial success alongside actor Mohan Babu.

news.title: Actor NTR Set to Resume Action Sequences for Dragon
news.summary: Following a recovery period from a shoulder injury and subsequent surgery, actor NTR is gearing up to return to the sets of his pan-India film Dragon. The upcoming 15-day Mumbai schedule, beginning on October 10, will feature high-octane action episodes alongside co-star Anil Kapoor. Directed by Prashanth Neel and produced by Mythri Movie Makers, the project is slated for a June 2027 release.

news.title: The Paradise Faces Crucial Box Office Test on Monday
news.summary: Nani's big-budget venture The Paradise enters a critical weekday phase after achieving strong opening weekend figures amidst mixed critical reception. Trade estimates indicate the movie accumulated significant gross earnings over the weekend, though it still faces a substantial gap to reach its target. With no major competing releases scheduled for the upcoming week, the film's ability to hold steady on Monday will dictate its ultimate commercial outcome.

news.title: Fresh Character Posters Drop for Upcoming Ramayana Adaptation
news.summary: The creators of the multi-part Ramayana project have revealed two striking new visuals featuring Yash as Ravana alongside the core trio of Ram, Lakshmana, and Sita. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari and backed by producer Namit Malhotra, the grand mythological venture features musical contributions from AR Rahman and Hans Zimmer. The cinematic adaptation is scheduled to roll out in two separate installments across Diwali 2026 and Diwali 2027.

news.title: Tabu’s Character Teaser Planned for Nagarjuna's Milestone King100
news.summary: The production team behind Nagarjuna Akkineni's landmark project King100 is preparing to launch a special video highlighting Tabu's involvement in the movie. This upcoming release marks a nostalgic onscreen reunion for the celebrated 1990s pair, who previously starred together in the blockbuster Ninne Pelladutha. Directed by Ra Karthik and featuring music by Devi Sri Prasad, the film is scheduled to hit theaters on December 24, 2026.

news.title: Makers of Vijay Deverakonda's Ranabaali Announce Four-Part Documentary
news.summary: Ahead of the theatrical arrival of Ranabaali on October 16, 2026, the creators are launching a four-part promotional documentary series titled Ranabaali: Never Forget. The upcoming series features lead actor Vijay Deverakonda, co-star Rashmika Mandanna, and director Rahul Sankrityan discussing two years of historical research into Rayalaseema. Produced by Mythri Movie Makers with a musical score by Ajay-Atul, the first episode debuts on social media tomorrow.

news.title: KTR Applauds Nani Starrer The Paradise After Theater Screening in Hyderabad
news.summary: BRS Working President KTR recently watched Nani's latest film, The Paradise, at Sudarshan Theatre in Hyderabad alongside various public representatives. He praised the movie for its authentic depiction of Telangana's culture, dialect, and the struggles of marginalized communities against oppression. Furthermore, he congratulated the lead actor, director Srikanth Odela, Priyadarshi, and the rest of the team for creating a powerful cinematic journey.

news.title: Report Highlights Rashmika Mandanna's Stronger OTT Market Value Over Sai Pallavi
news.summary: Industry sources indicate that leading streaming platforms are prepared to offer higher financial returns for female-centric projects starring Rashmika Mandanna compared to those featuring Sai Pallavi. This variance is reportedly driven by Rashmika's involvement in major pan-Indian blockbusters and her vast social media presence. Meanwhile, a prominent OTT platform has already secured a deal for an upcoming MS Subbulakshmi biopic headlined by Rashmika.

news.title: Nani's The Paradise Maintains Steady Ticket Sales on BookMyShow on Day Three
news.summary: Despite receiving mixed to polarized reactions, the Nani-starrer The Paradise continues to perform solidly at the box office, surpassing Rs. 115 crore in gross earnings over its first two days. On its third day, the movie sold 252,000 tickets on BookMyShow, matching its second-day momentum. Producer Sudhakar Cherukuri and director Srikanth Odela recently interacted with the media to discuss the project's ongoing theatrical run.

news.title: Wildcard Entrant Mithilesh Exits Bigg Boss Telugu Season 10 With Cash Prize
news.summary: In a surprising development on Bigg Boss Telugu Season 10, wildcard contestant Mithilesh accepted a Rs. 15 lakh temptation offer and chose to leave the house voluntarily. Having entered the show just a day prior, he defended his choice by stating he felt unable to shift the existing house dynamics or secure a victory. This rapid exit marks an unprecedented moment in the reality show's history.

news.title: Nani Expresses Joy Over The Paradise Audience Reception
news.summary: Actor Nani recently spoke at a media event in Hyderabad regarding the overwhelming success of The Paradise. He credited the relentless dedication of the entire cast, crew, and technical team for turning initial negativity into glowing positivity. Nani also shared high praise for his co-stars and technicians, highlighting the film's long-lasting appeal.
